rounding: round up to a complete 512-token block
overlay_storage_dtype: float16; update and regularization in float32
initialization: exact zero on first training lookup; evaluation never creates rows
optimizer: SGD without momentum; only current unique rows are parameters
schedule: cosine to 10% of peak across frozen 10M stream; 10M requires 5M success
regularization: CE + 0.1 * mean(||Delta_row||^2 / max(||PLE_row||^2, 1e-12)) over unique looked-up rows
precision: FP16 frozen backbone; FP32 frozen reader, arbiter, memory addition and CE; GradScaler with same-token retries

success.full_val: strictly lower NLL than matched v1
success.lambada: NLL <= matched v1 and accuracy >= matched v1
success.causal: REAL better than PERMUTED and DISABLED under the predeclared diagnostic rule

evaluation: unchanged frozen suite: 1024 full-val blocks, 64 blocks in each of five domains, 1000 LAMBADA items, 1000 HellaSwag items
